run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for load balancing a DataLoader from an LMDB dataset
run_get_data: run the get_data function to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a single dataset index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_function: run the make_lmdb_sizes function with argparse args to compute sorted atom and neighbor arrays for an LMDB dataset
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run the get_lmdb_sizes_parser function to create an argparse parser with data-path and num-workers arguments
review_make_lmdb_sizes: review the make_lmdb_sizes function to understand how it uses multiprocessing to extract natoms and neighbors from an LMDB dataset
